title: users can turn off alert types
rule: Users can turn off all alert types — products should allow this for people who need to focus.
pass_when: Alert types can be turned off.
fail_when: No way to turn off alert types.
overview: Products let users turn off alert types so people who need focus can silence them.
apply_when: Shipping toast or alert systems with configurable notification types.
not_when: Critical blocking errors or legal notices that must remain mandatory.
agent_hint: Provide a way for users to turn off alert types when they need to focus.
description: Spectrum expects products to let users turn off alert types so people who need to focus can silence non-essential noise. A system with no off switch traps users in constant interruptions. Offer per-type or equivalent controls for discretionary alerts; do not treat this as permission to hide critical blocking failures that the user must resolve.
